name: kevinbatdorf/retro-emulator
description: Native retro emulation for NativePHP Mobile apps via the ares emulator core

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Boot
bridge_functions.description: Bind to the named surface declared in the component tree; native creates the rendering surface

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.LoadSystem
bridge_functions.description: Initialise ares core for a system with system-level config

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.LoadRom
bridge_functions.description: Start emulation with ROM at given path; call again to swap ROMs

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.StageSlot
bridge_functions.description: Stage a Sufami Turbo slot ROM for the next slotted LoadRom

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Pause
bridge_functions.description: Pause emulation

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Resume
bridge_functions.description: Resume emulation

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Stop
bridge_functions.description: Stop emulator and teardown core

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.StateSave
bridge_functions.description: Snapshot full emulator state to slot

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.StateLoad
bridge_functions.description: Restore emulator state from slot

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.UndoStateSave
bridge_functions.description: Undo most recent state save

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.UndoStateLoad
bridge_functions.description: Undo most recent state load

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ReadMemory
bridge_functions.description: Sync RAM read — returns bytes directly

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ReadMemoryAsync
bridge_functions.description: Async RAM read — dispatches MemoryRead event

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.WriteMemory
bridge_functions.description: Write bytes to RAM

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.WatchMemory
bridge_functions.description: Register/merge address watches; fires MemoryChanged on value change

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.UnwatchMemory
bridge_functions.description: Remove specific address watches

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ClearMemoryWatches
bridge_functions.description: Remove all memory watches

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetAudio
bridge_functions.description: Merge audio options (volume, balance)

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetVideo
bridge_functions.description: Merge video options (luminance, saturation, gamma, etc.)

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Configure
bridge_functions.description: Merge general live options (speed, runAhead, rewind, etc.)

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ToggleRewind
bridge_functions.description: Enter or exit rewind playback

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetSystemOptions
bridge_functions.description: Merge system-specific options

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.FastForward
bridge_functions.description: Toggle fast-forward mode

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetInputMapping
bridge_functions.description: Merge controller input mappings for a port

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ConnectDevice
bridge_functions.description: Register or swap the controller device on a port

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetAxis
bridge_functions.description: Accumulate a relative axis delta on a port (mouse/light-gun)

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.AimAt
bridge_functions.description: Aim a light-gun at a normalized (0..1) screen position

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetRumble
bridge_functions.description: Enable/disable rumble for current controller

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetShader
bridge_functions.description: Load a .slangp shader preset by path; null clears

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.AddCheat
bridge_functions.description: Add a cheat code

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.RemoveCheat
bridge_functions.description: Remove a cheat code

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ClearCheats
bridge_functions.description: Remove all cheats

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.PressButton
bridge_functions.description: Set a single button state to pressed in the input state map

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.ReleaseButton
bridge_functions.description: Set a single button state to released in the input state map

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.SetButtons
bridge_functions.description: Atomically merge multiple button states into the input state map

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.Screenshot
bridge_functions.description: Capture current frame

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.GetStatus
bridge_functions.description: Return current emulator status (stopped/loading/running/paused)

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.GetRegion
bridge_functions.description: Return region of loaded ROM

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.GetPorts
bridge_functions.description: Return controller ports for current system

bridge_functions.name: Emulator.GetSystems
bridge_functions.description: Return all supported systems as rich objects
